570:     /** Shell tokenizer: single/double quotes keep groups together. */
571:     internal fun tokenize(line: String): List<String> {
572:         val out = mutableListOf<String>()
573:         val cur = StringBuilder()
574:         var quote: Char? = null
575:         var has = false
576:         var i = 0
577:         while (i < line.length) {
578:             val c = line[i]
579:             when {
580:                 quote != null -> {
581:                     if (c == quote) quote = null else cur.append(c)
582:                 }
583:                 c == '"' || c == '\'' -> { quote = c; has = true }
584:                 c.isWhitespace() -> {
585:                     if (cur.isNotEmpty() || has) { out += cur.toString(); cur.clear(); has = false }
586:                 }
587:                 else -> cur.append(c)
588:             }
589:             i++
590:         }
591:         if (cur.isNotEmpty() || has) out += cur.toString()
592:         return out
593:     }
594: 
595:     /** Glob match with `*`, `?` and `**` support. */
596:     internal fun globMatch(pattern: String, path: String): Boolean {
597:         val regex = buildString {
598:             append('^')
599:             var i = 0
600:             while (i < pattern.length) {
601:                 when (val c = pattern[i]) {
602:                     '*' -> if (i + 1 < pattern.length && pattern[i + 1] == '*') { append(".*"); i++ } else append("[^/]*")
603:                     '?' -> append('.')
604:                     else -> if (c in "\\^$.|+()[]{}") { append('\\'); append(c) } else append(c)
605:                 }
606:                 i++
607:             }
608:             append('$')
609:         }
610:         return Regex(regex).matches(path)
611:     }
612: 
613:     private fun cap(text: String): String =
614:         if (text.length <= MAX_OUTPUT) text else text.take(MAX_OUTPUT) + "\n… (обрезано)"
615: }

The build works. Now I have a good understanding. Let me enumerate the actual issues the user reported:

1. **"файлы не открываются, проекты не создаются а создаются файлы пустышки"** — Files don't open, projects don't get created, only empty stub files appear.
   - Looking at `createProject`: it writes `main.py` with DEFAULT_SCRIPT. That seems fine. But wait — the editor only ever handles `main.py` and `main.js`. There is NO file browser/workspace tree. The user says "файлы не открываются" (files don't open) — because there is no way to open any file other than main.py/main.js. When the agent creates files, the user cannot see or open them. That's the "workspace" complaint.
   - Actually more precisely: `EditorScreen` shows a fake "default script" in the editor if the file doesn't exist. `loadScriptForMode` returns DEFAULT_SCRIPT when the file is absent — so the editor shows content that is NOT in the file. That's the "файлы-пустышки" (empty dummy files) — the user sees text in the editor that isn't real, and it only gets written when you press "Сохранить и запустить". If they press "Стоп" or navigate away, nothing is saved. Also `runScript` for PYTHON writes the file. Hmm.
   - Critically: `EditorScreen` uses `rememberSaveable(selected?.name, mode) { mutableStateOf(script) }` — the local `text` is only committed on "Сохранить и запустить". Navigating tabs loses edits. And `viewModel.script` is never updated from the text field. So edits are lost.

2. **"нету нативного node js только заглушка"** — no native Node.js, only a stub. This is real: `JsRuntime` is Rhino + a hand-written Node-compatible shim (boot.js). PLAN.md §2.1 explicitly says nodejs-mobile was rejected. The user wants real Node.
   - This is a big one. Adding nodejs-mobile means adding a ~62MB per-ABI native lib. Let me check whether that's feasible. Actually, I should be honest with the user about the tradeoff here. Let me think about what's realistic.

3. **"нету tui терминала для аи а просто чат без workspace он чтоьо делает но не ясно появляется ли это что"** — no TUI terminal for the AI, just a chat without workspace, it does something but unclear what appears.
   - Real: there's no file tree / workspace view, no diff of what the agent changed, no live file changes. The user cannot see what the agent did.

4. **"сессии несохраняются пока их вручную не сменил не могу переключаться в любой момент сежлу сессиями"** — sessions don't save until you manually switch; can't switch between sessions at any time.
   - Real: `runAgentTurn` only calls `sessions.save(session)` at the END of the turn. If the app is killed mid-turn, or if the turn never completes, the session is lost. Also `switchTab` returns early `if (_agentRunning.value) return` — you cannot switch sessions while the agent is running. And the "sessions not saved" — actually they're saved at end of turn. But if the turn errors out via `catch`, `sessions.save` is not called (it's inside the try, before the catch). Let me re-check: `session.messages = newHistory; sessions.save(session)` happens after `agent.run` returns. `agent.run` catches Throwable internally. So save should happen. But if the process is killed, or the app is backgrounded... Also `_agentMessages` are UI-only until turn end.
   - Actually the biggest real issue: **there's no autosave during the turn**, and **you can't switch sessions mid-turn** (guarded by `_agentRunning`). Also the session list only refreshes at turn end.

5. **"нету diff и merg и пуш и другого чего либо"** — no diff, merge, push, etc.
   - Real: there is no local git at all. `github` tool does push via REST API but that's remote. No local repo, no diff view, no merge.

Let me now check the remaining pieces — GitHubClient, LlmClient, NpxRuntime, boot.js, and the tests — to see the true state.

The user's complaints fall into these buckets:

**A. Fake/empty behavior that must be fixed (honest, real bugs):**
- A1. Editor shows content that isn't on disk (phantom script). `loadScriptForMode` returns defaults without writing.
- A2. No file tree / no way to open any file. Only main.py/main.js. → This is "файлы не открываются".
- A3. Project creation writes a canned `main.py` — user says "проекты не создаются а создаются файлы пустышки". Actually the project IS created. But the auto-created `hello` project in `init{}` is a demo — `if (_projects.value.isEmpty()) createProject("hello")`. That's a demo stub to remove.
- A4. Editor edits lost unless you press run.

- A6. No visibility of what the agent changed.

**B. Big features the user wants:**
- B1. Real native Node.js (nodejs-mobile).
- B2. TUI-style terminal workspace for the AI.

Let me consider B1 seriously. nodejs-mobile: is it available? Let me check. The `nodejs-mobile` project provides `libnode.so` for Android ABIs. It'd be ~62MB per ABI. 282:         val body = JSONObject().put("ref", branch)
283:         ok(call("POST", "/repos/$repo/actions/workflows/$workflow/dispatches", body.toString()), "dispatch")
284:         return "workflow $workflow запущен (branch $branch). Дождаться результата: github run_wait {\"repo\":\"$repo\",\"timeout_sec\":600}"
285:     }
286: 
287:     fun runs(repo: String, limit: Int): String {
288:         val arr = JSONObject(get("/repos/$repo/actions/runs?per_page=${limit.coerceIn(1, 30)}", "runs"))
289:             .optJSONArray("workflow_runs") ?: JSONArray()
290:         val sb = StringBuilder()
291:         for (i in 0 until arr.length()) {
292:             sb.append(runLine(arr.getJSONObject(i))).append('\n')
293:         }
294:         return sb.toString().ifEmpty { "(запусков нет)" }
295:     }
296: 
297:     private fun runLine(r: JSONObject): String {
298:         val conclusion = r.optString("conclusion").takeIf { it.isNotEmpty() && it != "null" } ?: "…"
299:         return "run #${r.optLong("run_number")} id=${r.optLong("id")} ${r.optString("status")}/$conclusion " +
300:             "${r.optString("name")} (${r.optString("event")}, ${r.optString("created_at")})"
301:     }
302: 
303:     /**
304:      * Blocks until the run finishes — one tool call instead of a polling loop
305:      * that burns a round every few seconds. Reports the conclusion, the jobs
306:      * and, when something failed, the tail of the log, which is exactly what
307:      * "сборка упала, почему?" needs.
308:      */
309:     fun runWait(
310:         repo: String,
311:         runId: Long?,
312:         timeoutSec: Int,
313:         isCancelled: () -> Boolean = { false },
314:         logLines: Int = 40,
315:     ): String {
316:         val id = runId ?: latestRunId(repo)
317:         val budget = timeoutSec.coerceIn(15, MAX_WAIT_SEC) * 1000L
318:         val deadline = System.currentTimeMillis() + budget
319:         var run: JSONObject
320:         var waited = 0
321:         while (true) {
322:             run = JSONObject(get("/repos/$repo/actions/runs/$id", "запуск $id"))
323:             if (run.optString("status") == "completed") break
324:             val left = deadline - System.currentTimeMillis()
325:             if (left <= 0) {
326:                 return "запуск ${run.optLong("run_number")} (id=$id) всё ещё ${run.optString("status")} " +
327:                     "через ${timeoutSec}с — он продолжается на раннере; вызови github run_wait ещё раз " +
328:                     "или отмени его: github run_cancel {\"repo\":\"$repo\",\"run_id\":$id}"
329:             }
330:             if (isCancelled()) return "ожидание отменено пользователем (запуск $id продолжается на раннере)"
331:             val napMs = minOf(WAIT_POLL_MS, left)
332:             waited += napMs.toInt()
333:             Thread.sleep(napMs)
334:         }
335:         val sb = StringBuilder()
336:         val conclusion = run.optString("conclusion")
337:         val shown = run.optString("conclusion").takeIf { it.isNotEmpty() && it != "null" } ?: "…"
338:         sb.append("запуск #${run.optLong("run_number")} id=$id: ${run.optString("status")}/$shown «${run.optString("name")}»\n")
339:         sb.append("длительность: ${durationSec(run)}с, ожидание: ${waited / 1000}с\n")
340:         sb.append("ссылка: ${run.optString("html_url")}\n")
341:         jobsSummary(repo, id)?.let { sb.append(it) }
342:         if (!conclusion.equals("success", ignoreCase = true)) {
343:             sb.append("— логи (хвост) —\n")
344:             sb.append(logTail(repo, id, logLines))
345:         }
346:         return sb.toString()
347:     }
348: 
349:     private fun latestRunId(repo: String): Long {
350:         val arr = JSONObject(get("/repos/$repo/actions/runs?per_page=1", "runs"))
351:             .optJSONArray("workflow_runs") ?: JSONArray()
352:         if (arr.length() == 0) throw GitHubException("в $repo ещё не было запусков — сначала github dispatch")
353:         return arr.getJSONObject(0).optLong("id")
354:     }
355: 
356:     private fun durationSec(run: JSONObject): Long {
357:         val created = run.optString("created_at")
358:         val updated = run.optString("updated_at")
359:         return if (created.isEmpty() || updated.isEmpty()) 0 else seconds(created, updated)
360:     }
361: 
362:     /** ISO-8601 like 2026-09-27T10:00:00Z — parsed without java.time (API 26). */
363:     private fun seconds(from: String, to: String): Long = try {
364:         val format = java.text.SimpleDateFormat("yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ss'Z'", Locale.US)
365:         format.timeZone = java.util.TimeZone.getTimeZone("UTC")
366:         format.parse(to).time / 1000 - format.parse(from).time / 1000
367:     } catch (t: Throwable) {
368:         0
369:     }
370: 
371:     private fun jobsSummary(repo: String, runId: Long): String? {
372:         val arr = JSONObject(get("/repos/$repo/actions/runs/$runId/jobs", "jobs"))
373:             .optJSONArray("jobs") ?: return null
374:         if (arr.length() == 0) return null
375:         val sb = StringBuilder("задачи:\n")
376:         for (i in 0 until arr.length()) {
377:             val job = arr.getJSONObject(i)
378:             val conclusion = job.optString("conclusion").takeIf { it.isNotEmpty() && it != "null" } ?: job.optString("status")
379:             sb.append("  ${job.optString("name")}: $conclusion")
380:             val steps = job.optJSONArray("steps")
381:             if (steps != null && !conclusion.equals("success", ignoreCase = true)) {
382:                 val failed = mutableListOf<String>()
383:                 for (s in 0 until steps.length()) {
384:                     val step = steps.getJSONObject(s)
385:                     val sc = step.optString("conclusion")
386:                     if (sc.isNotEmpty() && sc != "success" && sc != "skipped") failed += step.optString("name")
387:                 }
388:                 if (failed.isNotEmpty()) sb.append(" (упали шаги: ${failed.joinToString(", ")})")
389:             }
390:             sb.append('\n')
391:         }
392:         return sb.toString()
393:     }
394: 
395:     private fun logTail(repo: String, runId: Long, lines: Int): String = try {
396:         val text = stream("GET", "/repos/$repo/actions/runs/$runId/logs").use { ins -> zipToText(ins, MAX_ZIP_TEXT) }
397:         val all = text.lines().filter { it.isNotBlank() }
398:         if (all.size <= lines) all.joinToString("\n").ifEmpty { "(логи пусты)" }
399:         else all.takeLast(lines).joinToString("\n").let { "…\n$it" }
400:     } catch (t: Throwable) {
401:         "не удалось прочитать логи: ${t.message ?: t.javaClass.simpleName}"
402:     }
403: 
404:     fun runCancel(repo: String, runId: Long): String {
405:         ok(call("POST", "/repos/$repo/actions/runs/$runId/cancel", "{}"), "отмена запуска")
406:         return "запуск $runId отменён"
407:     }
408: 
409:     /** Run logs come as a zip of per-job text files. */
410:     fun logs(repo: String, runId: Long): String {
411:         stream("GET", "/repos/$repo/actions/runs/$runId/logs").use { ins ->
412:             return zipToText(ins, MAX_ZIP_TEXT).ifEmpty { "(логи пусты)" }
413:         }
414:     }
415: 
416:     fun artifacts(repo: String, runId: Long?): String {
417:         val q = if (runId != null) "?run_id=$runId" else ""
418:         val arr = JSONObject(get("/repos/$repo/actions/artifacts$q", "artifacts"))
419:             .optJSONArray("artifacts") ?: JSONArray()
420:         val sb = StringBuilder()
421:         for (i in 0 until arr.length()) {
422:             val a = arr.getJSONObject(i)
423:             sb.append("id=${a.optLong("id")} ${a.optString("name")} ${a.optLong("size_in_bytes")} bytes (run ${a.optLong("run_id")})\n")
424:         }
425:         return sb.toString().ifEmpty { "(артефактов нет)" }
426:     }
427: 
428:     /** Lists an artifact's files and inlines the small text ones. */
429:     fun artifactDownload(repo: String, artifactId: Long): String {
430:         stream("GET", "/repos/$repo/actions/artifacts/$artifactId/zip").use { ins ->
431:             return zipToText(ins, MAX_ZIP_TEXT).ifEmpty { "(пусто)" }
432:         }
433:     }
434: 
435:     /** Escape hatch: any GitHub REST call, e.g. PRs, issues, releases. */
436:     fun api(method: String, path: String, body: String?): String {
437:         val m = method.uppercase()
438:         if (m !in setOf("GET", "POST", "PATCH", "PUT", "DELETE")) throw GitHubException("метод $m не поддерживается")
439:         if (!path.startsWith("/")) throw GitHubException("path должен начинаться с /, например /repos/owner/name")
440:         val answer = call(m, path, body?.takeIf { it.isNotBlank() })
441:         val text = ok(answer, "api $m $path")
442:         return if (text.isBlank()) "(пустой ответ ${answer.status})" else pretty(text)
443:     }
444: 
445:     // ---------------------------------------------------------------- zip
446: 
447:     /** Reads a zip stream: lists entries and inlines the small text ones. */
448:     private fun zipToText(ins: InputStream, cap: Int): String {
449:         val sb = StringBuilder()
450:         java.util.zip.ZipInputStream(ins).use { zip ->
451:             var entry = zip.nextEntry
452:             val buf = ByteArray(8192)
453:             while (entry != null && sb.length < cap) {
454:                 if (!entry.isDirectory) {
455:                     sb.append("── ").append(entry.name).append('\n')
456:                     if (looksTexty(entry.name)) {
457:                         val text = StringBuilder()
458:                         while (true) {
459:                             val n = zip.read(buf)
460:                             if (n <= 0 || text.length >= cap - sb.length) break
461:                             text.append(String(buf, 0, n, Charsets.UTF_8))
462:                         }
463:                         sb.append(text).append('\n')
464:                     }
465:                 }
466:                 entry = zip.nextEntry
467:             }
468:         }
469:         return sb.toString().take(cap)
470:     }
471: 
472:     private fun looksTexty(name: String): Boolean {
473:         if (name.endsWith(".png") || name.endsWith(".jpg") || name.endsWith(".jar") || name.endsWith(".apk") ||
474:             name.endsWith(".zip") || name.endsWith(".dex") || name.endsWith(".so") || name.endsWith(".bin")
475:         ) return false
476:         return true
477:     }
478: 
479:     private fun plural(n: Int, one: String, few: String, many: String): String = when {
480:         n % 10 == 1 && n % 100 != 11 -> one
481:         n % 10 in 2..4 && n % 100 !in 12..14 -> few
482:         else -> many
483:     }
484: }

(End of file - total 484 lines)
</content>

import org.json.JSONArray

/**

 * manage repositories and **GitHub Actions runners** entirely from the app:
 * create a repo, commit files (including workflow files under
 * `.github/workflows`) in a single atomic commit, dispatch a workflow, block

 * real compilers — which is the "heavy work" escape hatch of the mobile
 * sandbox.

1. **"исправь заглушки и убери демки только реальный код"** — fix stubs, remove demos, only real code.
2. **"файлы не открываются, проекты не создаются а создаются файлы пустышки"** — files don't open, projects don't get created, instead empty stub files appear.
3. **"нету нативного node js только заглушка"** — no native Node.js, only a stub.
4. **"нету tui терминала для аи а просто чат без workspace он чтоьо делает но не ясно появляется ли это что"** — no TUI terminal for the AI, just a chat without a workspace; it does something but it's unclear whether it appears.
5. **"сессии несохраняются пока их вручную не сменил не могу переключаться в любой момент между сессиями"** — sessions don't get saved until manually changed; can't switch between sessions at any time.
6. **"нету diff и merge и пуш и другого чего либо"** — no diff, merge, push, or anything else.

Let me verify each against the actual code:

**Complaint 2: files don't open, projects don't get created, empty stubs**

Looking at `EditorScreen.kt:59`:
```kotlin
var text by rememberSaveable(selected?.name, mode) { mutableStateOf(script) }
```
This is a real bug. `rememberSaveable` with keys `selected?.name, mode` — when the project changes the text resets, but the crucial problem: `viewModel.saveScript(text)` is only called from `runScript`. If the user edits and switches tabs, the edit is lost. Also `rememberSaveable` persists across process death via SavedStateHandle — meaning a stale editor buffer can be restored.

More critically — **there's no file browser at all**. The editor can ONLY edit `main.py` and `main.js`. That's it. The agent creates files via `write`/`apply_patch` tools, but the user has NO WAY to open them in the UI. That's exactly "файлы не открываются" (files don't open).

And "проекты не создаются а создаются файлы пустышки" — Let me check `createProject`:
```kotlin
fun createProject(rawName: String) {
    val name = rawName.trim()
    if (name.isEmpty()) return
    val dir = workspace.projectDir(name)
    val main = File(dir, "main.py")
    if (!main.isFile) main.writeText(DEFAULT_SCRIPT, Charsets.UTF_8)
    refreshProjects()
    _projects.value.firstOrNull { it.dir == dir }?.let { select(it) }
}
```
This does create. But `loadScriptForMode` returns `DEFAULT_SCRIPT` when file doesn't exist — so the editor SHOWS a default script for a file that doesn't exist on disk. If the user opens the Node tab, they see `DEFAULT_JS_SCRIPT` but no `main.js` exists. That's the "файлы-пустышки" (empty dummy files) — the editor shows content that isn't on disk. And the ProjectsScreen says "main.py · N строк" showing 0 lines for a project that has no main.py.

Also `init { if (_projects.value.isEmpty()) createProject("hello") }` — auto-creates a demo "hello" project. That's a demo/stub the user wants removed.

**Complaint 3: no native Node.js, only a stub.** The PLAN.md explicitly says this: Rhino + a hand-written Node-compatible layer. `JsRuntime.VERSION = "Rhino 1.8.1 (ES6,interpreted)"`. The user wants real native Node.js. This is a big change — nodejs-mobile / libnode.so. Let me consider: the plan doc §2.1 rejected it. But the user is now explicitly asking for native Node. Adding `libnode.so` for arm64-v8a + x86_64 = ~124MB, plus JNI binding. That's a huge lift and CI has a size concern. I should check feasibility.

Actually let me reconsider the scope. This is a very large request. Let me be pragmatic and prioritize what's genuinely broken and fixable, and be honest about the Node.js native part.

**Complaint 4: no TUI terminal for AI, just a chat without workspace.** The AgentScreen is a pure chat. There's no file tree, no diff view, no indication of what files the agent created/changed. "он что-то делает но не ясно появляется ли это что" — it does something but it's unclear whether the files appear. Confirmed: no workspace view in the agent screen.

**Complaint 5: sessions don't save until manually changed, can't switch any time.** Looking at the code: `sessions.save(session)` is only called at the END of `runAgentTurn` (line 536). If the app is killed mid-turn, or the turn errors, the session is lost. Also `runAgentTurn` catches Throwable and adds an Error item but the `session.messages = newHistory; sessions.save(session)` lines are INSIDE the try — so on exception, nothing is saved. That's the bug: **the turn's work is lost if anything throws**.

Also `switchTab` returns early `if (_agentRunning.value) return` — so you cannot switch sessions while the agent is working. "не могу переключаться в любой момент между сессиями" — exactly.

**Complaint 6: no diff, merge, push.** There's a `github` tool with push (to GitHub), but no LOCAL git. No diff view, no merge. The MiniShell explicitly says "No git". Confirmed missing.

Let me now plan. This is a big scope. Let me think about what's the highest-value, actually-correct work:

**A. Real file workspace (fixes "files don't open", "empty stubs")**
- New `core/FileTree.kt` — recursive listing, path resolution, create/rename/delete, binary detection.
- AppViewModel: real open-file state (`openFile: StateFlow<FileRef?>`), `openFile(path)`, `saveFile(path, text)`, create/rename/delete.
- New `ui/FileTreeScreen.kt` or a file drawer in the editor: real tree, tap to open ANY file.
- EditorScreen: edit the actually-open file, not just main.py/main.js. Dirty state, save button, discard.
- Remove the auto-created "hello" demo project and the fake default scripts shown for non-existent files. Instead: empty project, user creates files. Or ask.

**B. Agent workspace view (fixes "no Tui/workspace, unclear what appears")**
- The agent screen needs a workspace panel showing the file tree that updates live as the agent writes.
- Live "changed files" tracking during a turn — a diff preview of what the agent just did.

**C. Sessions (fixes "not saved", "can't switch")**
- Save the session incrementally (on every event), not just at turn end.
- Save in a `finally` block.
- Allow switching tabs while running (per-tab state).

**D. Git: init/status/diff/commit/merge/push**
- This is substantial. A real local git implementation in Kotlin. Options: JGit (a dependency), or implement a minimal git. JGit is the sane choice — it's pure Java, works on Android. Let me check if it's available.
- Add JGit dependency, implement `core/GitService.kt` with init/status/diff/commit/log/branch/merge.
- Agent tools: `git_status`, `git_diff`, `git_commit`, `git_log`, `git_branch`, `git_merge`, `git_push` (remote via https with token).
- MiniShell: `git` command wired to the same service.

**E. Native Node.js**
- nodejs-mobile libnode.so. Let me check size/feasibility. This is risky — needs JNI C++ that can't be tested without a device. Let me check whether it's worth attempting and be honest with the user.
